UTILITIES / SCREEN RECORDER

Show it, as it happens.

Record your screen with optional audio, then preview and download locally.

Capture what you want to show

Record a browser tab, window or screen. Your browser lets you choose the source; the recording stays on this device.

Desktop browsers work best

Screen capture and shared audio depend on your browser and system. No screen or microphone access until you start.

Both audio options start off. Choose “Share audio” in the browser picker when available. Requested quality: up to 1080p at 30 fps; the browser decides the actual capture size.

00:000 MB

Ready. Nothing is being captured.

Automatically stops after 10 minutes elapsed or at 250 MB. Recording continues while this tab is in the background. Leaving the page releases capture; download your result before leaving.

Your preview

A live preview and your finished recording appear here.

Downloads use a supported native WebM or MP4 format. Preview audio is muted during capture to prevent feedback. Files are not uploaded or stored in your account.
